scenes.line1: LLMs can get pricey and slow.
scenes.line2: How do you keep them fast?
scenes.say: LLM apps can get expensive and laggy fast. How do you keep things quick and affordable?

scenes.label: Batching
scenes.sub: Send multiple prompts in one request.
scenes.say: First, batch your prompts. Sending several at once cuts down on both cost and wait time.
Cache repeated questions, switch to smaller models for easy jobs, and keep your prompts short to use fewer tokens.

scenes.question: Should you always use the biggest model?
scenes.right: No—smaller models are faster and cheaper for simple tasks.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: should you always use the biggest model? Nope. For simple tasks, smaller models are faster and way cheaper.
